# NFT.com

> > NFT.com is a social marketplace for creating, trading, and discovering NFTs with community-driven features and Web3 education.

NFT.com combines a fee-free NFT marketplace with social networking capabilities, allowing users to create profiles, mint collections, and engage with NFT communities. The platform provides comprehensive educational content covering blockchain basics, emerging use cases, and market analysis for both beginners and experienced collectors.

## Key Topics

- NFT (Non-Fungible Token)
- Web3
- Blockchain
- Ethereum
- NFT Marketplace
- Digital Assets
- Self-Custody
- Crypto Wallet
- NFT Minting
- NFT Community
- DAO
- Discord
- Profile Creation
- Collection Management
- Cryptocurrency

## Core Platform

- [NFT.com Homepage](https://www.nft.com): NFT.com homepage: social marketplace for trading and displaying NFTs
- [Mint Profiles](https://www.nft.com/app/mint-profiles): Create and manage NFT profiles on NFT.com's social marketplace

## Beginner's Guides

- [What Is an NFT? A Guide to Web3 in 2023](https://www.nft.com/articles/what-is-an-nft): Fundamental guide explaining NFTs, blockchain, and Web3 basics
- [What is a crypto wallet?](https://www.nft.com/articles/what-is-a-crypto-wallet): Guide to crypto wallets, security, and tools like Metamask and Rainbow
- [Finding the right NFT community for you](https://www.nft.com/articles/finding-the-right-NFT-community-for-you): Beginner's guide to finding NFT communities on Discord and DAOs

## Market Insights & Analysis

- [What does the FTX collapse mean for NFTs?](https://www.nft.com/articles/what-does-the-FTX-collapse-mean-for-NFTs): Analysis of FTX collapse impact on NFT market and crypto ecosystem
- [The 10 most expensive NFT sales - Full Breakdown](https://www.nft.com/articles/most-expensive-nft-sales): Analysis of record-breaking NFT sales including Beeple and CryptoPunks
- [Why is everyone creating NFTs in 2022?](https://www.nft.com/articles/emerging-use-cases-for-nfts): Explores emerging NFT use cases and new market growth opportunities

## NFT Drops & Collections

- [The Weekly NFT Drop: April 17-23](https://www.nft.com/articles/the-weekly-nft-drop-april-17-23): Weekly roundup of NFT drops including Starbucks and Yuga Labs projects
- [7 NFT Games we are watching this year](https://www.nft.com/articles/nft-games-you-can-play-now): Roundup of playable NFT games including Axie Infinity and blockchain games

## Blog & Resources
